name: GDPR
scopeNote: GDPR is a data-protection regulation, not a software security standard. SAST provides only INDIRECT technical evidence toward the security-of-processing and data-protection-by-design obligations. This catalog covers the security/accountability-relevant articles (Ch. II principles, Ch. IV controller/processor obligations); the remaining ~90 articles (lawful basis, data-subject rights, transfers, supervisory authorities) are legal/organizational and out of SAST scope.

controls.title: Integrity and confidentiality principle
controls.summary: Personal data is processed in a manner ensuring appropriate security, including protection against unauthorised or unlawful processing.

controls.title: Responsibility of the controller
controls.summary: The controller implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure and demonstrate compliant processing.

controls.theme: Data Protection by Design and by Default
controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.summary: Data-protection principles and safeguards are built into processing by design and by default, including data minimisation.

controls.title: Processor security obligations
controls.summary: Processors provide sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures.
implementationChecklist: Implement appropriate security measures as a processor

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.summary: Controllers and processors maintain records of processing activities under their responsibility.

controls.title: Encryption and pseudonymisation of personal data
controls.summary: Implement appropriate measures including encryption and pseudonymisation of personal data.
implementationChecklist: Encrypt personal data in transit and at rest

controls.title: Confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience
controls.summary: Ensure the ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services.
implementationChecklist: Protect personal data from injection and unauthorized access
evidenceExamples: Injection / access control / information exposure findings

controls.title: Restore availability and access after an incident
controls.summary: Ability to restore availability and access to personal data in a timely manner after a physical or technical incident.

controls.title: Regularly test and evaluate security measures
controls.summary: Process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures.

controls.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
controls.summary: Notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within 72 hours where feasible.

controls.title: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject
controls.summary: Communicate high-risk breaches to affected data subjects without undue delay.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.summary: Carry out a DPIA where processing is likely to result in a high risk to individuals.
